question: Within Dayville, Oregon, what share of the area has elevation at or above 80 meters?
sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-119.541779 44.467607, -119.541784 44.472724, -119.543197 44.472809, -119.543208 44.474625, -119.539078 44.474542, -119.536386 44.471055, -119.531096 44.471031, -119.531078 44.469035, -119.526368 44.469031, -119.52634 44.465411, -119.520384 44.465365, -119.520297 44.461657, -119.536571 44.461753, -119.536556 44.462346, -119.533907 44.462303, -119.533893 44.462877, -119.533979 44.463996, -119.541779 44.467607))',4326) AS geom
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.geom) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
hist AS (
  SELECT
    (vc).value::double precision AS val,
    (vc).count::double precision AS cnt
  FROM clipped c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_ValueCount(c.rast, 1, TRUE) AS vc
)
SELECT
  (
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN val >= 80 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0)
    / NULLIF(SUM(cnt), 0)
  ) * 100.0 AS answer_percent
FROM hist;
